research.title: Support Request Classification with Lexical Baselines
bullets: Prepared labeled support requests by removing duplicate messages, standardizing category labels, and checking training and evaluation partitions for overlapping text.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines under an established protocol, examining confusion matrices and misclassified requests with ambiguous intent.

research.title: Sentence-Level Relevance Detection in Product Reviews
bullets: Cleaned review sentences and checked relevance annotations against supplied guidelines, flagging inconsistent labels and preserving document boundaries during dataset splitting.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier using supplied settings and inspected false positives associated with product mentions lacking substantive feature descriptions.

work.title: Routine Operations and Records Support
bullets: Maintained routine inventory records, checked incoming deliveries against order paperwork, and referred discrepancies to the responsible staff for resolution.
Organized filing materials, prepared supplies for scheduled activities, and tracked outstanding administrative requests through established handoff and follow-up procedures.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with TF-IDF Sentence Ranking
bullets: Implemented a baseline summarizer that ranked sentences by similarity to a document centroid and selected sentences within a specified length budget.
Compared generated summaries with lead-sentence selections, reviewing coverage of central topics and redundancy introduced by repeated terms across sentences.

projects.title: Character N-Gram Baselines for Language Identification
bullets: Prepared short text samples with consistent language labels and implemented a multinomial naive Bayes baseline using character n-gram counts.
Evaluated predictions on held-out samples and inspected errors involving borrowed words, closely related languages, and texts with limited alphabetic content.
